2608.04652.title: DisMix: Order-Aware Mixup for Medical Imaging via Disentangling Ordinal and Non-Ordinal Features
2608.04652.paper_summary: Image mixup is a widely adopted data augmentation strategy, yet it is ill-suited for ordinal classification tasks such as medical disease grading, where labels encode a progression of severity. By indiscriminately blending disease-severity cues (ordinal) with appearance-level variation (non-ordinal), standard mixup produces samples that distort the very ordinal structure that underpins clinical severity grading. We introduce DisMix, an order-aware mixup framework for ordinal classification. DisMix disentangles ordinal and non-ordinal features via a dual-codebook VQ-VAE, allowing each subspace to be mixed independently: ordinal codes are interpolated to produce meaningful intermediate ranks, while non-ordinal codes are varied to introduce appearance diversity without corrupting the ordinal signal. Across four medical imaging datasets, DisMix shows the best aggregate performance among six image mixup baselines paired with six ordinal classifiers and remains effective under data scarcity and clinical grading variability.
2608.04652.paper_summary_zh: 圖像混合是一種廣泛採用的數據增強策略，但它不適合於如醫療疾病分級這樣的序數分類任務，因為在這些任務中，標籤編碼了嚴重程度的進展。通過不加區分地將疾病嚴重程度的線索（序數）與外觀層次的變化（非序數）混合，標準混合生成的樣本扭曲了支撐臨床嚴重程度分級的序數結構。我們介紹了DisMix，一個針對序數分類的順序感知混合框架。DisMix通過雙碼本VQ-VAE解開序數和非序數特徵，使每個子空間可以獨立混合：序數碼被插值以生成有意義的中間等級，而非序數碼則被變化以引入外觀多樣性，而不損害序數信號。在四個醫療影像數據集上，DisMix在六個圖像混合基準和六個序數分類器的配對中顯示出最佳的綜合性能，並在數據稀缺和臨床分級變異性下仍然有效。
